name: Raging Blasters 2
storyline:
In the year XXX of the Universal Century.
The Raging Blasters were ordered to deploy immediately to deal with a defense system that had suddenly gone out of control.
The mission was a success, and the incident was handled as a top-secret matter.
However, after ten years, the defense system began to run out of control once again.
The newly formed Raging Blasters were ordered to deploy immediately.
Now, a new battle for Raging Blasters begins.
summary: The sequel to the "Raging Blasters" is here! It's called "Raging Blasters 2". This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup. Players choose from three pilots to control, and head into battle. The graphics are pixel-perfect, and the music includes chiptune versions.
